simple.meaning: גָּבִישׁ (gâbîysh) is a Hebrew word meaning “crystal (from its resemblance to ice).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

definitions.full: H1378. gabish גָּבִישׁ noun masculine crystal (compare אֶלְגָּבִישׁ hail — on relation of meanings compare Greek κρύσταλλος , & Ethiopic usage of Di Lex. Aeth.759 — Arabic gypsum , Assyrian gibšu , mass, abundance , COT Gloss ) — וְגָבִישׁ רָא֯מוֺת Job 28:18 coral and crystal .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (probably meaning to freeze);

occurrences.englishText: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal.
